title: fq-segment/1 — tensor index (index-kK.json)
description: Per-layer entry point into a K family: for each MoE layer, the segment file, its digest and size, the offset where the safetensors body starts, and every expert's [lo, hi) byte span RELATIVE TO THE BODY. Absolute file offsets are body_offset + lo .. body_offset + hi, which is exactly the HTTP Range a consumer asks for (see fq_fetch). Keys are decimal layer numbers as strings; expert keys likewise. Derived from index-k3.json / index-k4.json / index-k5.json as emitted by fq_repack, fq_prime and fq_fetch.

sha256.description: digest of the WHOLE segment file as published; a subset file fetched by fq_fetch has its own local digest here, which deliberately differs from the publisher's full-file digest

body_offset.description: 8 + header length: where tensor payload starts

additionalProperties.description: [lo, hi) body-relative byte span of one expert's tensors, contiguous by construction

sources.description: fq_fetch only: which repo@revision each expert's bytes came from
